title: HorseRacing2
description: Horse racing with 7 bet types - Requires EmeraldBank [ALPHA]
body:
# HorseRacing2 - Horse Racing

> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION** - This plugin is in development. Bugs may exist.

## ⚠️ Required: EmeraldBank

**[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) is REQUIRED!**

### Installation
1. Download [EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2)
2. Download HorseRacing2
3. Put both in plugins folder
4. Restart server

---

## Features

- **7 Bet Types** - Win, Place, Quinella, Exacta, Wide, Trio, Trifecta
- **Odds System** - Dynamic odds with configurable takeout rate
- **Horse Stats** - Strength, Stamina, Intelligence
- **GUI Betting** - Easy-to-use interface
- **Bet Ticket Item** - Right-click to open betting

## Bet Types

| Type | Description | Picks |
|------|-------------|-------|
| Win (単勝) | Pick 1st | 1 |
| Place (複勝) | Pick top 3 | 1 |
| Quinella (馬連) | 1st & 2nd (any order) | 2 |
| Exacta (馬単) | 1st & 2nd (exact order) | 2 |
| Wide (ワイド) | 2 in top 3 | 2 |
| Trio (3連複) | Top 3 (any order) | 3 |
| Trifecta (3連単) | Top 3 (exact order) | 3 |

## Odds Range

| Bet | Min | Max |
|-----|-----|-----|
| Win | 1.2x | 2.5x |
| Place | 1.1x | 1.5x |
| Quinella | 1.5x | 5.0x |
| Exacta | 3.0x | 15.0x |
| Wide | 1.3x | 3.0x |
| Trio | 3.0x | 10.0x |
| Trifecta | 8.0x | 30.0x |

## Commands

### Player
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/horseracing bet` | Open betting GUI |
| `/horseracing getbetitem` | Get bet ticket |

### Admin
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/horseracing start` | Start/stop race |
| `/horseracing stop` | Emergency stop |
| `/horseracing setup spawn/lobby` | Set locations |
| `/horseracing sethorse <count>` | Set horse count |
| `/horseracing sethousepoint <num>` | Set start position |
| `/horseracing setlocation <num>` | Set checkpoint |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `horseracing.admin` | All admin | op |
| `horseracing.bet` | Place bets | true |

## Configuration
```yaml
betting:
  takeout_rate: 0.2
  minimum_odds: 1.1

horse_stats:
  strength: {min: 5, max: 10}
  stamina: {min: 4, max: 9}
  intelligence: {min: 3, max: 8}
```

## Requirements

- **[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) (REQUIRED)**
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---
